hook: Ranking the most painful parkour fails from 5 to 1!

items.line: Number 5: Trying to vault into a dumpster and ending up stuck inside it.
Number 4: Slipping off the wall mid-vault and slamming straight to the ground.
Number 3: The wall flip attempt where both feet slip out from under him.
Number 2: Sliding along the rail and losing balance completely.
Number 1: The backflip attempt that ends with a hard fall to the pavement!
